summary: Read the aftermath receipt (CheckRun e96c2de31b4e452d80622d05c92a5b22) as-is and recorded a child-level interpretation: the acceptance defect and its electoral consequence reproduce in two independent streams of the file (forged message accepted at indices 13 and 22; candidate StateLeader at term 3 at index 25), so the mechanism is not a single-scenario artefact. The three bound comparisons I actually wanted (deposed incumbent shedding leadership, anchor equal to the committed prefix, incumbent following the new leader) came out unknown because of a defect on my side — one stream's campaign-request event omitted the identity field the admission alias required ('Missing operation admission fields or identity' at event 11) — so the raw aftermath observation at index 26 is deliberately not counted and the bounds stay open. I requested one successor of the same fixed experiment (previous_id e4fc0a862aa0426eb128344d68ef7b76-experiment) that adds only that field to both streams, verified locally (both campaign events now carry it, all three tests pass); validation passed with the execution requested. Incomplete: that corrected receipt is still pending, and the bounds it targets remain unmeasured in the current account.
